scope: scripts/qualify_fio_tag_routes.py on a Debug build of 48bf67a8, 96/96 steps (run fr_0220f89d), on a German TIA V21 installation in one owned scratch with the standard CPU 1511-1 PN and an added CPU 1511F-1 PN 6ES7 511-1FL03-0AB0/V4.1 (configureScratchSecurity, failsafeRuntimeAccess; owned scratch only) plus an ET 200SP station with two F-DI on its IO system (the first F-DI's inputs start at byte 0).
